steps.action: Negative: Create contract refuses a blank Title, a missing Contract type, a blank required Field and an invalid number; archived references are not offered; Cancel creates nothing
steps.expected: Each refusal shows an error in the dialog and no Contract is created; archived type, Entity and person are absent.
steps.actual: Blank Create said "Name the contract."; with a Title only it said "Pick a contract type.". The type list omitted archived "Framework agreement"; Owner omitted archived Gabriel Santos and Business Users and started on Nadia Haddad. The fixture type showed its required and optional Fields; blank required Field said "Fill DOC-029 contracts-a Required number 1789572933571 — this contract type requires it."; a non-number said "DOC-029 contracts-a Required number 1789572933571: enter this as a number.". Cancel on a complete draft closed the dialog; the Contracts API lists no Contract with that title.

steps.action: Create the record: Title, Contract type, Fields, Owner, Confidential, optional Matter search, Create
steps.expected: The app opens the new Contract with its title, type, Legal Owner and a new C- reference, in the Draft Status; the chosen Owner is Legal Owner and the creator is on the team as Creator.
steps.actual: The dialog selected Matter "M-18" (help text in dialog: "Link only when this Contract is part of broader Matter work. Nothing else flows across the link."). Create opened /contracts/187 directly. Header: "Contracts C-187 DOC-029 contracts-a legal_team_member C14 1789572933571 Draft Draft Review Approval Signature Active Ended". Overview Contract type MSA, Legal Owner "DO Daniel Okafor"; Confidential true; the Governing law Field saved. Contract team: "Contract team DO Legal Owner Daniel Okafor NH Creator Nadia Haddad". MSA has 0 default people, so no one else joined.

steps.action: A link does not copy access: a Legal Team Member outside the Confidential team reads the Matter but not the Contract
steps.expected: The Matter answers; the Confidential Contract is refused for the reader outside its team.
steps.actual: Marcus Oyelaran: Matter M-18 answered 200; Contract C-187 answered 404; his page did not show the title ("C-187 does not exist, or you cannot open it. Back to Contracts").

steps.action: Rename keeps the C- reference
steps.expected: The reference stays the same after a rename.
steps.actual: Contract actions > Rename contract focused the Overview Title (true); the new title saved on Enter; header now "Contracts C-187 DOC-029 contracts-a legal_team_member C14 1789572933571 renamed Draft Draft Review Approval Signature Active Ended".

Business Owner Jonas Weber saved. Our entity omitted the archived Portugal Entity; Not known yet cleared it. No Department and No Region cleared those choices. Priority High and Risk Low saved. Description after Enter only: null; it saved when focus left. With Frequency Other and a blank Custom cadence, pressing Enter did not save (value API still null or earlier; page note present: true); with "each milestone" the group saved {"amount":1250000,"currency":"EUR","cadence":"other","cadenceDescription":"each milestone"}. After reload: {"legal":"NH\nNadia Haddad","business":"JW\nJonas Weber","entity":"Helix Software Ltd","department":"Finance","region":"EMEA","amount":"12,500","cadence":"each milestone","description":"DOC-029 fictional services description."}. steps.expected: A new name offers a create action; the first linked party is primary; Make primary moves the designation; removing a link keeps the Counterparty record.

"Take DOC-029 contracts-a legal_team_member Counterparty 1789572933571 off the contract" left one linked party, and the Counterparty search still returns the record.

steps.action: Ended Contracts stay editable

observations: The shared work lab also holds records and accounts from other DOC-029 groups. Picker lists quoted in the steps include those accounts (for example "DOC-029 access Administrator 96054"). The script asserted only that Business Users (Jonas Weber, Ravi Menon) and archived Gabriel Santos were absent, so phrases such as "offered only staff" and "no Business Users" mean exactly that check.

Setup API calls, not article steps, created the Contracts for V-C15, V-C16 and V-C17-manual, put Jonas Weber on those teams, requested the Soft gate approval in V-C15, requested Tom Iwu in V-C16, and moved the Legal Owner to Nadia Haddad before her cancellation in the Administrator run. The records list marks the setup Contracts.
API readbacks and direct API writes confirmed saved values and refusals (403, 404, 409). They are supporting checks beside the browser actions, not substitutes for the written steps.

Earlier trial runs of this script on the same lab, with the same article bytes, failed on harness assumptions only: the Owner button text carries avatar initials; Rename contract focuses the Overview Title instead of opening a dialog; Playwright fill("") on the formatted Amount input did not clear the draft, while click, Ctrl+A and Backspace did; a Legal Team Member who is not requester or Legal Owner has no Actions button on another person's approval row; the Approvers checkbox list carries avatar initials; the Matters list pages at 50 rows; the reader needed more than 30 s to render once; the fixture type archive needs a JSON body. Each was fixed in the script and the full run repeated. This log holds only the final complete run. Trial runs left extra fictional DOC-029 contracts-a records in the lab, and one aborted trial left fixtures that were archived afterwards.

Setup fixtures (a Contract type with a required number Field and an optional long-text Field, a Review-Stage Contract Status, and an Approver group) were created by Daniel Okafor through the API and archived at the end of the run; the cleanup list records the archive results.
limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by an agent that did not write the guides; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
Contributor is a former account type (DD-023). Ravi Menon is now a Business User without a password in this lab, so Business User refusals used Jonas Weber through a new Portal magic link.
create-contract: MSA has no default people, so "Default people set for the Contract type also join the team" was not exercised. A Generation of an Auto-Doc creating a Contract was not exercised here.
contract-stages: a competing change that requires a fresh review was not exercised.
contract-approvals: notification delivery and email preferences were not checked.
manual-signing: a failed upload, and recording a withdrawn or declined hand-off in a conversation, were not exercised.
Browser contexts were 1280x900 CSS px. The Status menu had 11 options during the run and every option was reachable; the crowded-menu issue #768 is not claimed fixed.
